weapons.title: Ranged weapons
weapons.description: Firearms for general catches, bosses and flying targets.

weapons.title: Melee & explosives
weapons.description: Ammunition-saving finishers and physics-based achievement tools.

items.title: Story items
items.description: Single-route objects that must be kept until their boss or NPC hand-in is complete.

items.title: Navigation & upgrades
items.description: Permanent tools that improve travel and unlock the next route.

bait.title: Regular lure tiers
bait.description: Purchased lure tiers with weighted catch pools for Islands 2 through 5.

bait.title: Special shop bait
bait.description: Purchased bait with a small, dedicated catch pool rather than a full island tier.

bait.title: Boss lures
bait.description: Purchased lures for optional or route-specific encounter creatures.

bait.title: Story bait
bait.description: Quest-made triggers that should not be sold, cooked or substituted.

bait.title: Encounter triggers
bait.description: Defeated bodies used to start the next fight; these are not equippable lures.

npcs.title: Lighthouse
npcs.description: The first progression hand-in and boat-key route.

npcs.title: Forest Island
npcs.description: The Leech Bait story chain and the first full fishing-and-weapon shop.

npcs.title: Desert Island
npcs.description: The Carrot, Pufferfish and cooking routes plus the island utility kiosk.

npcs.title: Rocks Island
npcs.description: Story hand-ins, tackle and weapon counters, roulette and the Drip trophy slot machine.

npcs.title: Volcano Island
npcs.description: Separate military, store and Scientist records that converge on the final whale route.
